data.claim: main's only remaining red named by Beea98b1aa7 is channel.consent, an operator-only gated verb added by 613cb2ff9 (ADP-notify-knobs) that is neither covered by a digest Source nor in EXEMPT_SITES.
data.falsifier: unregistered_sites() == [] before any change (channel.consent already covered or exempt).
data.mechanism: digest.sources.unregistered_sites() reports every approvals/sites.SITE verb not in a Source.sites tuple and not in EXEMPT_SITES; channel.consent was added to SITES without a matching entry, so the OD-inventory test test_every_operator_only_verb_is_covered_or_exempt fails.
data.question: Is the residual red of bug Beea98b1aa7 a single unregistered operator-only verb (channel.consent) with no other red left on main?

evidence.note: research R5a990aef8b CONFIRMED: ran pytest tests/test_digest_sources.py on main -> test_every_operator_only_verb_is_covered_or_exempt and test_unregistered_verb_is_reported fail with channel.consent unregistered (only residual red of Beea98b1aa7).

Read r-consent-outward and decisions D7e0d117ba5 (channel consent once-per-kind, no expiry) and D-OD-Q2/Q8 (digest sources table complete; an operator-only verb must be covered or exempt). channel.consent relays channels.grant_consent into the generic approval ask, matching the EXEMPT_SITES pending-is-an-approval-entry pattern (config.set, pins.regenerate, history.accept).

data.claim: The one red of the ef4ba75f set still failing on current main (beside perf-shifted arch_deps/remedy_texts) is tests/test_command_registry.py::test_generated_subparser_help_equals_the_hand_written_one[wait]: the real  command grew a  param the hand-written WAIT Command fixture in tests/test_command_registry.py lacks.
data.falsifier: [wait] passing before any change (fixture already had notify).
data.mechanism: The test parametrizes [release,wait,approve] and asserts the CLI help generated from the hand-written WAIT Command equals the real  subparser help; the notify param exists only in the real command (ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle/navigate.py), so generated != real.

evidence.note: research Rfb0e570fb9 CONFIRMED: test_command_registry[wait] red = the wait Command grew a notify param that the hand-written WAIT fixture lacks; probe reproduced 1 failed (wait) then the notify param fixed it (3 passed).

Added the missing notify Param to the WAIT Command fixture in tests/test_command_registry.py (help text mirrors ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle/navigate.py notify cli_help), commit db24dabba. test_command_registry[release,wait,approve] now 3 passed.
Fix is a test-fixture sync under r-everything-configurable and r-agent-parity: the WAIT Command twin must mirror the real wait subparser (its params and cli_help), which the notify addition restores.

chunk_findings.detail: This is the entire fix for B4e431e0082, and it only inserts a hand-written `notify` Param on the wait spec. The bug as filed is main red on many tests that this diff cannot affect, including `test_generated_subparser_help_equals_the_hand_written_one[approve]`, `test_every_module_named_in_the_architecture_doc_exists`, `test_the_current_code_has_exactly_the_knobs_and_event_kinds_the_manifest_gives_it`, `test_every_adapter_module_is_under_twenty_kib[mcp.py1]`, `test_a_valid_saved_order_is_adopted_so_the_cold_read_does_not_sort`, `test_configured_names_are_redacted`, `test_no_mutually_importing_pair_has_a_module_level_edge`, `test_the_connection_survives_the_exec`, `test_every_command_printed_advice_names_exists`, the brief-recovery cases, `test_ratchet_violations_match_baseline`, and `test_heartbeat_from_the_tree_does_not_resurrect_an_expired_lease`. Re-running those on this tree still fails exactly as on ef4ba75f, because no production code or those tests changed. Even the wait case is only an oracle edit: if generated help does not already contain this exact `notify` help string, `test_generated_subparser_help_equals_the_hand_written_one[wait]` stays red.
